objective_change: base_link and the distal system are now inside the objective, unlike A3.2c
headline: the complete stowed B601 system (base_link + links1-6 + gripper_link + 2 fingers) does not fit the nominal 12U envelope under any of the 16 optimised cases; the minimax protrusion is +7.99 mm/face at 0 deg hard-limit margin and +8.67 mm/face at 2 deg, both above the 6.5 mm CDS allowance

decolocation_hypothesis.hypothesis: de-colocating ROOT_BASE_BAY and DISTAL_STOW_BAY along X would recover the fit
decolocation_hypothesis.evidence: the explicit de-colocation penalty changed nothing: root/distal axial overlap stayed at 77.1-82.8 mm in all 16 cases, with and without the penalty. The overlap is structural: links2+3 are 264.0 and 248.5 mm, so the chain must fold back over its own root inside a 366 mm envelope.

subset_finding: neither the base nor the gripper breaks the fit on its own. BASE+LINKS16 fits at 0 deg (-1.80) and misses at 2 deg (+2.81). LINKS16+GRIPPER fits at both (-3.00 / -2.06). Only the combination fails (+7.99 / +8.67). They compete for the same volume around the folded root.
corridor_cost: the links1-6 corridor thickness rises from 80.3 mm (A3.2c, links1-6 only) to 90.8-113.9 mm once base and gripper are in the objective
what_would_be_needed: about 16 mm must come out of each of the three global dimensions (382.0 -> 366.0 and 242.3 -> 226.3)
options_not_evaluated_here: separately stowed or detachable gripper: LINKS16+GRIPPER already fits at 2 deg, and BASE+LINKS16 nearly fits, so removing the gripper from the stowed arm bundle is the smallest geometric change - but it is NEW_MECHANISM_REQUIRED and OUT_OF_SCOPE for the current baseline
a deployer whose lateral allowance exceeds 8 mm: no such ICD exists in the repository
Mode B (12U-class free flyer without deployer constraint)
